This '''group''' was founded around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haurgab]]. It was composed of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] sympathetic to the cause of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and helped them fight the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This group was closely aligned with the [[Maujasi]]
clans from the [[Maujas Desert]], and aided them in fighting the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. They were located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Haurgab, [[Hadde]].

==History==
Because [[Hadde]] was seen as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-friendly [[City/Legends|city]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was an immense advantage to the group because the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] located at the [[Hadde Base|base]] in Hadde would not expect an attack from within friendly territory. The rebels used this to their advantage, launching a missile strike at Hadde Base which killed many clone troopers. However, the Republic forces managed to track the trajectory of the missiles to a house currently occupied by the group and the resulting [[Raid on Hadde|raid]] killed and captured those responsible. This raid was the end for the group of rebels, though the Republic would later withdraw from Haurgab.

==Equipment==
This group used [[Huntmaster missile]]s and also had in their possession a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]], [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]] and [[Mortar/Legends|mortars]].
